properties.description: Built 2026-10-18 (item 4 of req:a-proof-can-state-a-contradiction-cases-suppositions-and-cited-theorems). A theorem, lemma or corollary marked `taken_as_given` is a CITATION (CITED_KINDS; a proposition taken as given stays a stated position an argument starts from, because the argument designs use propositions as premises): statement_reading reads `cited` when an Artifact with a checksum DOCUMENTS it (the source as read, pinned) and `cited_unverified` otherwise (recalled, or named only in `source` text), never `taken_as_given` as an axiom does. As a premise it holds as cited; an unverified one is carried (Read.unverified) by every step and claim resting on it, which read `rests_on_unverified`, ClaimTruth `conditional` and proof_status `conditional`, never plain holds. loop_status counts `unverified_citations` (confirmation owed) and the unconfirmed_reasoning gap names them. Trial shapes: Brocard B6 (a recalled theorem turned into holds), π+e P4 (theorem + taken_as_given worked while the skill said a theorem is never taken as given). Measured: π+e's theorem shown → conditional on 2 citations; Brocard 2 lemmas shown → conditional on Fermat's little theorem; Fermat's design 1 claim.
properties.name: A theorem, lemma or corollary cited from elsewhere reads cited, distinct from an axiom, and an unverified citation leaves what rests on it conditional, never plain holds
